'''Vegg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After becoming stranded in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], Vegg joined the [[Coalition]], a group of businesses that sought to control all trade in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], hoping that he could earn enough money to purchase a new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] for his [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. Vegg was paired with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nilloc]] and was present in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] when it was [[Battle of Tolea Biqua|attacked]] by the [[Cularin Militia]].
